prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Quillene Rook. Character visual motifs: masked archer with hawk-inspired shoulder fins and bow strung with miniature kite rigging; feathers are **air anchors**, not returning blade traps.
TOP LEFT: Airborne Fletching. Ability concept: every third aimed attack releases a tiny kite that hangs for 3 s at the shot's endpoint (max 3). Kites are visible and destroyable.
TOP RIGHT: Tetherbolt. Ability concept: shoots a kite anchor 150 GU into the air; anchors do not damage when planted.
BOTTOM LEFT: Crosswind Stitch. Ability concept: ties her two nearest kites into an aerial span for 3 s. Her next two arrows passing through it split into two shallow angled shots at 60% damage each (one-hit cap per target); enemy units may shoot down either kite.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Harrier Net. Ability concept: all active kites fan into a broad descending mesh. Enemies inside may move out but have ranged attack windups increased for 2.5 s; meanwhile allied projectiles from outside the mesh get a slight side-angle adjustment. No untargetable leap, ground feather recall, or root-on-three-feathers.
